The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm. On it are a fresh summer roll (rice paper with vegetables and possibly noodles) and about 6 fries.

The roll is roughly 10-11 cm long and 3.5 cm wide. I estimate it at about 80 g and 100 kcal.

The fries are small, about 6 pieces at roughly 25 g in total, which comes to about 80 kcal.

Together that is about 105 g and 180 kcal.
